fields.description: Issue includes coverage of a warrant and affidavit connected to an embezzlement charge involving Dr. Earl Moore (described as Miami’s “Torture Doctor”), and related court reporting including sentencing in a “crime against nature” case. Editorial and political content argues against a Florida sales tax and calls for reduced state spending and administrative economy. Local civic and public-safety items include a Dade County Red Cross hurricane-preparedness message and reports/columns on Miami traffic court and policing. Entertainment and nightlife coverage appears in the “Mason at Midnight” column and venue listings/advertising, alongside discussion of housing conditions and alleged graft in FHA-related development projects.
